generate_completion_greedy_training: generate greedy text completions from a prefix using autoregressive model inference with log-probability tracking
generate_completion: generate text completions with top-k and top-p sampling from a prefix token sequence
_sample_topp: sample vocabulary tokens using nucleus (top-p) filtering over cumulative probability mass
_topk_decode: decode next tokens using greedy, top-k, or top-p sampling strategies while masking pad tokens
top_k_logits: mask logits to keep only the k highest values for top-k sampling
